patterns.note: A minimalist, full-bleed dark background (black) with high-contrast light typography (white) creates a stark and sophisticated visual foundation.
The main brand identity and key headings use an oversized, bold, geometric sans-serif typeface, often in uppercase, which contrasts with smaller, clean sans-serif for navigation and body text.
The primary color scheme is strictly monochromatic (black and white), with subtle, muted accent colors appearing within specific content blocks or project imagery.
The main 'STINK STUDIOS' logo at the top of the page dynamically transforms from a solid white fill to a white outline as the user scrolls past the initial hero section.
Content sections, particularly individual project listings, reveal with a subtle fade-in or slide-up animation as they enter the viewport during scrolling.
Project and news listings are presented as a vertical stack of full-width entries, each clearly delineated with a title, date, and category, rather than a traditional multi-column grid.

technique_notes: The site employs a full-bleed dark background with high-contrast light typography to establish a bold and modern aesthetic.
A sticky header is implemented where the main logo dynamically changes its visual style (from solid to outlined) using GSAP or similar animation library, triggered by scroll position.
Content sections, such as project entries, are revealed using scroll-triggered animations, likely leveraging GSAP ScrollTrigger, where elements fade or slide into view as they enter the viewport.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, bold, uppercase sans-serif for the main logo and some hero text, with a clear hierarchy down to smaller, clean sans-serif for navigation and body text.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp (all elements, including buttons and content blocks, maintain crisp, unrounded corners).
design_tokens.spacing: Airy (generous vertical spacing between sections and individual content entries, creating a sense of openness and allowing elements to breathe).

standout: The most distinctive aspect is the dynamic transformation of the main logo from a solid fill to an outline as the user scrolls, which provides a subtle yet impactful brand interaction. This, combined with the stark, high-contrast black and white aesthetic and bold typography, creates a sophisticated and memorable user experience that feels premium and intentional.
